thought.text: Now let me update the production section of `config/secrets.yml` with the secret_key_base and server_name:

reasoning_content: Got the secret_key_base. Next, update the production block in secrets.yml: set secret_key_base, server_name, and configure mailer. Let's update it.

action.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
c = open('config/secrets.yml').read()
sk = "046e75d3ce6d0d7f8185a455cb8457ed7a72fc692a85a2932c838375c7eeb03af72c1d423d0f4638fa44be76aae7680ab4e9efaa60f55b637d8c36221f89ae6d"
prod = "production:"
idx = c.index(prod)
head, tail = c[:idx], c[idx:]
lines = tail.split("\n")
out = []
replaced_sk = False
replaced_server = False
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    out.append(line)
    if not replaced_sk and line.strip() == '# secret_key_base: ""' and i > 0 and lines[i-1].strip() in ("production:",):
        out[-1] = '  secret_key_base: "' + sk + '"'
        replaced_sk = True
    if not replaced_server and line.strip() == 'server_name: ""':
        out[-1] = '  server_name: "localhost"'
        replaced_server = True
newc = head + "\n".join(out)
open('config/secrets.yml','w').write(newc)
print("secret_key_base set:", replaced_sk, "| server_name set:", replaced_server)
EOF
grep -n "secret_key_base\|server_name" config/secrets.yml | tail -6
